description.narrative: O.O.2. Number of registered voters.

comment.narrative: The figure of 1467604 is the actual number of registered voters accounting for 91 of eligible voters as published by the ECN on 2 August 2024.The previously entered target value of 1509775 was based on rough estimates as no percentage of eligible voters was available for the 2029 election year. This was likely due to the lack of uptodate Census data. According to earlier calculations this target reflected 87.18 of the total eligible voters. However a mistake was made as the Census data includes foreigners residing in Namibia who are not eligible to vote. Therefore the actual number of registered voters for the 2024 elections was entered instead.Available Census Data 2011 total population 2113077 2023 total population 3022401Estimated total population in 2019 2719293 based on recursive reasoningExplanation the estimated average population growth is 75777 p.a. being equal to 3022401 211307712 years Eligible voters of 2023 Census 2023 2024 1731790 18 years being equal to 573 of total populationEstimated eligible voters of 2019 1558155 based on recursive reasoning of which 1358468 are registered voters Baseline value representing 8718 of the total eligible votersConsequently estimated registered voters in 2024 1509775 being equal to 8718 of the total eligible voters 1731790

comment.narrative: The Baseline value is based on a survey hand sign with photovideo footage during the A 1.2.
